caption:
47 payment screenshots and you still can't tell who paid 🧾

it's 1am and the orders chat has 47 unread. "dah transfer sis 🙏" with a screenshot. "done ya" with another one. 3 of them are RM45, from 3 different people, for 3 different orders. 1 has the name cropped out. 1 is so blurry you're just guessing.

then you open the bank app and try to match each line to a chat. somewhere in there is the customer who paid last week and is now asking why nothing's been sent.

3 free fixes you can start tomorrow:
1. ask for the order number in the transfer reference, every time
2. 1 order, 1 transfer. no "this one covers my 2 orders"
3. check the bank statement once a day, not once per screenshot

if you're doing this every night, it's probably time for a proper checkout. our e-commerce stores come with DuitNow / FPX payments at checkout, order emails and an admin panel to run it all. the customer pays on the site, not in your chat. RM8,000–20,000, details at harnova.my.
